description: Search every upcoming event in one What's Up In city (Boston, Chicago, Los Angeles, Orange County, Sacramento, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Albuquerque, Almaty, Anchorage, Atlanta, Baltimore, Bangkok, Beijing, Berlin, Buffalo, Cairo, Cancún, Cape Town, Cincinnati, Cleveland, Dallas-Fort Worth, DC, Denver, Detroit, Guangzhou, Havana, Honolulu, Houston, Inland Empire, Las Vegas, London, Mexico City, Miami, Minneapolis-St. Paul, Montreal, Nashville, New Orleans, New York, Paris, Philadelphia, Phoenix, Pittsburgh, Portland, Richmond, Rome, Salt Lake City, San Juan, Savannah, Seoul, Shanghai, St. Louis, Sydney, Tokyo, Toronto, Vancouver): music, dance, AI/tech, arts, comedy, food, sports, classes, volunteering, street fairs. Use it for "what's on in <city> this weekend", "free comedy near <neighborhood>" and the like. All words in `query` must match title/location/performers/organizer/tags. Dates are the city's local dates, YYYY-MM-DD. Each event links to its original listing (`link`) and carries an `id` for get_event.

city.description: Which city (name or slug): Boston, Chicago, Los Angeles, Orange County, Sacramento, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Albuquerque, Almaty, Anchorage, Atlanta, Baltimore, Bangkok, Beijing, Berlin, Buffalo, Cairo, Cancún, Cape Town, Cincinnati, Cleveland, Dallas-Fort Worth, DC, Denver, Detroit, Guangzhou, Havana, Honolulu, Houston, Inland Empire, Las Vegas, London, Mexico City, Miami, Minneapolis-St. Paul, Montreal, Nashville, New Orleans, New York, Paris, Philadelphia, Phoenix, Pittsburgh, Portland, Richmond, Rome, Salt Lake City, San Juan, Savannah, Seoul, Shanghai, St. Louis, Sydney, Tokyo, Toronto, Vancouver. list_cities has the full list.

near.description: Events within radius_km of a place in the city: a neighborhood, a town, a venue name, or "lat,lon". Results get distance_km, nearest first within each day.

neighborhood.description: Only events in this neighborhood or town of the city, e.g. 'Capitol Hill', 'Silver Lake', 'Cambridge'. Events whose venue isn't mapped can't be placed and are left out (place.unplaced_events counts them).

query.description: Free text, e.g. 'salsa', 'hackathon', 'street fair', an artist or venue

radius_km.description: Distance for near (default 1.5, max 50), or how far neighborhood reaches past its boundary (default 0)

topic.description: Topic, e.g. comedy, film, food_drink, sports, talks, classes, markets, outdoors

town.description: Only events in this town or city within the metro, e.g. 'Oakland', 'Pasadena' (case-insensitive)

name: search_events
title: Search events in one city
